Position: Tableau Developer 
 Location: Bellevue, WA 
 Project Type: Contract. 
 
 Job Description 
 · Exceptional analytical, conceptual, and problem-solving abilities. 
 · Demonstrable proficiency with Data Visualization tools Tableau. 
 · Advanced knowledge of data visualization design theories, principles and applications. 
 · Advanced knowledge of SQL , including the ability to write stored procedures, analytic/windowing functions, and tuning. 
 · Experience in Tableau Desktop, Tableau Server and Tableau Reader. 
 · Experience including analysis, modeling, design, and development of Tableau reports and dashboards for analytics and reporting applications. 
 · Comfortable working on large data sets. 
 · Knowledge of relational and dimensional database structures, theories, principles, and practices. 
 · Good experience in DevOps tools. 
 · Automating configuration management, infrastructure, and application deployments in a toolset such as Puppet, Chef. 
 · Ability to provision, monitor and scale AWS infrastructure. 
 · Experience in Linux admin. 
 · Good scripting knowledge. 
 Regards
 Nithya 


 If you are interested in the below position please forward your profile to  nithyar@usmsystems(dot)com or call me on 703-794-2380.
